rts_adaptations: Retain visible projectile flight; adjudicate packet once at first arrival.
Commit same-second launches before automatic evasion starts, to avoid entity-ID first-mover advantage.
One packet per aircraft per60s; selecting one missile commits that opportunity.
Fitted aircraft countermeasures are automatically used when evading per9.5.1; no extra invented chaff percentage is stacked.
9.5.1 applies outside a dogfight. Once a non-TARH packet controller evades, the saved packet remains permanently unguided even after the incoming threat has disappeared.
9.4 target-speed modifiers for aircraft inside a dogfight use source cruise speed at the fight altitude, independent of plotted speed or FMP fuel accounting.

English2026 PDF105 section9.5.1 requires the surprised/nonmaneuvering declaration when the AAM is fired. The saved launch Attack.maneuvering is this declaration; false keeps MR0 and halves the eligible current countermeasure modifier at physical arrival. Current hardware, signature, speed, damage and guidance remain live; a declaration-window expiry cannot cancel the original declaration.

night_dogfight.source: Harpoon V2026-01-01 English PDF104/printed9-3 section9.4.8; visually verified; Chinese RAG core_rules_cn:p104:c02 cross-check
night_dogfight.procedural_adaptation: Commands execute before the source sensor pass each one-second RTS tick. Consume only own observer/sensor/target successful scan evidence from this or the immediately preceding tick; this is a pipeline bridge, not a published extra detection-retention time. Fused contacts, another observer, Visual/FLIR/ESM, a damaged or disabled receiver, future timestamps and older evidence do not satisfy the onboard condition. IR mode bindings are static scenario/source fits; a future runtime mode-switch feature must snapshot acquisition mode.
